summary: Shows embedding filter plugins in a role's `filter_plugins` directory, making them usable in Jinja templates in roles called after it.
questions: How do I ship a custom filter plugin inside a role?
Which roles can use a filter plugin embedded in a role?

answer_card.title: Embed filter plugins in roles
answer_card.answer_md:
Put them in a `filter_plugins` directory in the role:
```text
roles/
  my_custom_filter/
    filter_plugins/
      filter1
      filter2
```
The filters can then be used in Jinja templates in any role called after `my_custom_filter`.
